Yuna Ogata (Japanese: 緒方佑奈 Ogata Yūna) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Ogata was born on July 31 in Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan and became a voice actress as an adult. Ogata first worked on Pokémon voicing in Pokémon: Twilight Wings before joining the voicing minor recurring character Vic. She gained her most notable role during when she voiced Liko's classmate Ann. Ogata is currently affiliated with .
